_doc: The one list of Blocked reason tags (specs/board.md FR-BRD-6). Writers: block-template.md and every lane that moves a card to Blocked. Readers: drover-status.py (grouping), drover-approval.py and drover-deps.sh (needs_you). Add or rename a tag here only.

tags.[blocked:creds]: credentials or secrets: missing API key, expired token, no test login
tags.[blocked:quota]: billing or quota: paid API rate limit hit, free tier used up, plan upgrade needed
tags.[blocked:access]: permissions: gh scope denied, org admin required, write access missing
tags.[blocked:unclear]: ambiguity or spec gap: two valid readings, AC contradicts PROJECT.md, dependency unclear
tags.[blocked:unsafe]: safety or destructive step: would drop a table, push to prod, rotate live secrets
tags.[blocked:review]: human review needed: unresolved human PR comment, product or branding decision
tags.[blocked:design]: pure design: no measurable AC, needs a design pass first
tags.[blocked:duplicate]: pre-flight: a merged PR already delivers it, or an open PR or card is building it
tags.[blocked:sequenced]: pre-flight: an open PR touches the same files; waits on the issue that PR closes
tags.[blocked:too-big]: over the merge_policy.auto_max_lines cap or spans many areas; split it with /to-tickets
tags.[blocked:ci]: CI cannot run or stays red for a reason outside the diff (Actions budget, broken runner)
tags.[blocked:schema]: destructive schema or API contract change that needs a human ruling
tags.[blocked:rebuild-cap]: rebuild_cap reached on the same card with the same root-cause hash
tags.[needs-you]: a step only a human may run: merge gate exit 7 (merge_policy holds the merge) or exit 8 (a migration the robot may not run, a failed migrate, a declared needs-you step)
